title: Larger text requests and clearer model listings
summary:
Text requests got four times the character room, model listings got clearer, and image fallback took a more direct route.

The text request limit rose from 512,000 to 2,048,000 characters. Model listings now identify `openai` as GPT-4.1-mini and `openai-large` as GPT-4.1; `openai-reasoning` and `gemini` were removed from the available-model list.

Referral-link insertion became less frequent, including when trigger words match. The affiliate selection was also adjusted.

When Cloudflare Dreamshaper fails, image generation now falls through to the general ComfyUI call instead of trying a dedicated Turbo fallback first.

daily.title: Clearer text model listings
daily.text: `openai` is now listed as GPT-4.1-mini and `openai-large` as GPT-4.1, making the choice between the two IDs clearer. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Larger text requests
daily.text: Text requests now accept up to 2,048,000 characters, up from 512,000, so larger inputs need less splitting. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
